<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21022023-09-181" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon" part="M" next="ex21022025-10-0312-56-34">
          <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (91a6-8)"/>
       <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4625"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3742">mdos sde kun las btus pa</rs>'i ti ka mdo' nyi ma'i snying po</rs> zhes bya ba | thugs kyi me long yongs <lb n="91a7"/> su dag pa la byang chub kyi sems rgya chen po × snang zhing dben pa'i gnas la thugs gzhol ba mtshan nas brjod par dka' ba'i <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6392">slob dpon dbang phyug rin chen</rs> zhes bya ba'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos blangs nas | mkhas pa'i skye bo chen po lung dang rigs pa la rtogs pa'i snang pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3876">chos kyi <abbr>ye shes</abbr></rs> zhes bya <lb n="91a8"/> ba dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">brtson 'grus seng ge</rs> zhes bya ba'i legs par bshad pa la sgro skur gnyis dang bral bar smra ba | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3911">shag kya'i dge slong gzhon nu rin chen</rs> gyis legs par sbyar ba || || rdzogs sh+O || || bkra shis par gyur gcig|| </seg></TEI>
